question: Can the isolated superabundant equigeneric point forced by 05R/05S be ruled out by its obstruction dimension, a standard virtual count, or expected-codimension Severi intersection theory?

parent_05r.exact_use: For every r=0..28, M=omega_D tensor phi^*omega_Q^{-1} has degree -162+2r<0 and H^0(M)=0, so any required low-genus image is equigenerically isolated.

parent_05s.exact_use: All first-order map deformations supplied by the pair-map normal sheaf are torsion and die under the first-order image-deformation map; common-cover structure does not contradict equigeneric isolation.

parent_05n_same_target_counterexample.exact_use: On the identical target Q=C2xC2, the diagonal Delta:C2->Q exists with h0(N_Delta)=0, h1(N_Delta)=3 and virtual dimension -3. Thus isolated obstructed maps of negative virtual dimension exist on this target.

dedieu_sernesi.title: Equigeneric and equisingular families of curves on surfaces
dedieu_sernesi.exact_use: The conductor/adjoint ideal controls the equigeneric tangent cone; failure of the restriction map to be smooth is precisely the mechanism by which global equigeneric loci can be superabundant.

chiantini_ciliberto.title: On the Severi varieties of surfaces in P^3
chiantini_ciliberto.exact_use: Smooth projective surfaces can have nonempty superabundant Severi components even when the expected dimension is negative; negative expected dimension is not a general emptiness theorem.

behrend_fantechi.title: The intrinsic normal cone
behrend_fantechi.exact_use: A perfect obstruction theory produces a virtual fundamental class of the virtual dimension. Virtual intersection data record obstruction excess; they do not identify set-theoretic support with the virtual cycle.

exact_obstruction_saturation.interpretation: The entire negative expected-dimension deficit is already accounted for by the exact obstruction cohomology of the member-specific conductor-twisted normal line bundle. There is no leftover sign or rank contradiction.

counting_boundary.reason_1: A virtual class records the obstruction theory at the expected dimension, not the set-theoretic nonemptiness of an obstructed moduli space.
counting_boundary.reason_2: The identical target already contains the diagonal, an isolated obstructed negative-virtual-dimension curve, so no target-wide principle of the form isolated plus negative virtual dimension implies nonexistence is legal.
counting_boundary.reason_3: Known superabundant Severi examples on smooth projective surfaces show that negative expected dimension can coexist with actual curves when the global-to-local restriction is non-transverse.

decision.exact_blocker: A nonexistence theorem must use geometry not already encoded by the obstruction rank: local singularity type, self-identification/double-point structure, full monodromy, or an actual member equation. Standard expected-dimension or virtual-count formalism is blind to the set-theoretic existence of this isolated obstructed point.
decision.reopen_condition: Reopen only with a source-bound local invariant whose value is forced nonzero/positive for every isolated target member but is incompatible with the exact V6/common-cover data.

breadth_audit.trigger: The same isolated-superabundant receiver survived 05S and 05T, and the preferred route reached a pure virtual-count theorem gate; cycle anti-optimization trigger applies.

generated_views.reason: Use the exact normalization map, delta=7984-r, common-ramification torsion tau, and self-intersection 15806 to separate nonimmersive singularity contribution from self-identification contribution. This attacks actual local geometry rather than virtual dimension.

Decisive reconstruction remains owned by EX2 and should only be imported through an exact adapter.
